dedupe_keys.name: drivendata stac overflow sentinel 1 sar image chips with floodwater labels from flood events worldwide 2016 2020

description: STAC Overflow: Map Floodwater from Radar Imagery is a DrivenData challenge data set for detecting floodwater in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery. Contents: Sentinel-1 radar image chips captured between 2016 and 2020 over flood events in different regions of the world, stored as GeoTIFFs of 512 by 512 pixels, with one image per polarisation band and two bands per chip; pixel values are backscatter in decibels and 0.0 marks missing data. Training chips carry pixel-level water or no-water labels and metadata with country and date, and users could add permanent water and elevation layers through the Microsoft AI for Earth STAC API. Producer: DrivenData, with supporting data from the Microsoft Planetary Computer (AI for Earth) STAC API. Coverage: flood events on several continents, 2016 to 2020. Format and access: competition data from DrivenData after sign-up, with an open data section on the challenge page; winning solutions were released under the MIT licence per the competition rules. Licence: governed by the competition terms. Caveats: chips sample selected events, not all floods, and SAR confuses water with smooth surfaces and shadows. Simulation uses: training and testing flood extent mapping for emergency response and hazard exposure of roads, settlements and utilities. Related records: data-etci-2021-sentinel1-flood-detection-dataset and data-esa-worldcover.
